form.label: Vault Transaction Trace: Who Read This Secret
form.description: Correlates a secret access back to the workload that made it: a Kubernetes service account, a CI pipeline, or a named auth identity. Metadata only; audit logs carry HMAC'd values, so no secret value can be rendered here.

html.div: Metadata only. The Vault audit device HMACs every secret value before writing it, so no panel here can render a secret: there is no secret value in the input. Community-built asset, not a HashiCorp product feature.

Workload identity varies by auth method. Kubernetes logins populate auth.metadata.service_account_name, so a row reads as cluster/namespace/service-account. Other auth methods do not, and fall back to auth.display_name. If every row here collapses to one value, your auth method is not writing identity metadata; that is a mount configuration question, not a dashboard fault.

search.query: index=vault_audit sourcetype="vault:audit" type=response request.path="$pathfilter$" | eval k8s_sa = 'auth.metadata.service_account_name' | eval workload = if(isnotnull(k8s_sa) AND k8s_sa!="", coalesce('auth.metadata.kubernetes_cluster',"no-cluster") . "/" . coalesce('auth.metadata.service_account_namespace',"default") . "/" . k8s_sa, coalesce('auth.display_name',"unknown")) | eval vault_ns = if(coalesce('request.namespace.path',"")=="", "root", 'request.namespace.path') | search workload="$workload$" vault_ns="$nsfilter$" | stats count AS ops BY workload | sort - ops | head 1 | table workload

"/" . coalesce('auth.metadata.service_account_namespace',"default") . 'request.path' | eval err = coalesce('error', 'response.data.error') | eval result = if(isnotnull(err) AND err!="", "ERROR", "ok") | eval when = strftime(_time, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | table when workload result request.operation vault_ns secret request.mount_type request.remote_address auth.entity_id | rename 'request.operation' AS operation, 'request.mount_type' AS mount, 'request.remote_address' AS source_ip, 'auth.entity_id' AS entity_id | head 200

panel.title: Who reads this secret. Set the path filter first, then read this as the rotation blast list.

search.query: index=vault_audit sourcetype="vault:audit" type=response request.mount_type=kv request.operation=read request.path="$pathfilter$" | eval secret = coalesce('request.namespace.path',"") . 'request.path' | eval k8s_sa = 'auth.metadata.service_account_name' | eval workload = if(isnotnull(k8s_sa) AND k8s_sa!="", coalesce('auth.metadata.kubernetes_cluster',"no-cluster") . "/" . coalesce('auth.metadata.service_account_namespace',"default") . "/" . k8s_sa, coalesce('auth.display_name',"unknown")) | eval vault_ns = if(coalesce('request.namespace.path',"")=="", "root", 'request.namespace.path') | search workload="$workload$" vault_ns="$nsfilter$" | stats count AS reads, min(_time) AS first_seen, max(_time) AS last_seen, dc('request.remote_address') AS source_ips, values('auth.policies{}') AS policies BY secret workload | eval first_seen = strftime(first_seen,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"), last_seen = strftime(last_seen,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"), policies = mvjoin(policies, ", ") | sort - reads | head 100

panel.title: Shared credentials: secrets read by more than one workload. A rotation here is an outage in more than one place.

search.query: index=vault_audit sourcetype="vault:audit" type=response request.mount_type=kv request.operation=read request.path="$pathfilter$" | eval secret = coalesce('request.namespace.path',"") . 'request.path' | eval k8s_sa = 'auth.metadata.service_account_name' | eval workload = if(isnotnull(k8s_sa) AND k8s_sa!="", coalesce('auth.metadata.kubernetes_cluster',"no-cluster") . "/" . coalesce('auth.metadata.service_account_namespace',"default") . "/" . k8s_sa, coalesce('auth.display_name',"unknown")) | eval vault_ns = if(coalesce('request.namespace.path',"")=="", "root", 'request.namespace.path') | search vault_ns="$nsfilter$" | stats dc(workload) AS consumers, values(workload) AS who, count AS reads BY secret | where consumers > 1 | eval who = mvjoin(who, ", ") | sort - consumers | head 100
